title: Collecting Duckweed Samples For Microbial Community Profiling
author: Kenneth Acosta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.98zh9x6
materials: Flash freeze and store at -80C until processing.

steps.title: Prepare filtration apparatus
steps.instruction: Obtain a 150 mL 0.2 µm filter unit and lay a sterilized Miracloth on top of the unit.

steps.title: Collect and filter water sample
steps.instruction: Collect 150–300 mL of water, pour it through the sterilized Miracloth into the filter unit.

steps.title: Filter water via vacuum
steps.instruction: Turn on the vacuum and filter the water sample through the 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Cut water filter and transfer
steps.instruction: Using a sterile scalpel, cut the 0.2 µm filter from the unit and place the filter into a 5 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Collect duckweed tissue
steps.instruction: Collect 1–3 g of fresh‑weight duckweed from the environmental sample and place it into a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash duckweed with sterile water
steps.instruction: Wash the duckweed tissue twice with sterile water.

steps.title: Rinse duckweed and filter rinsate
steps.instruction: Rinse the tissue 3–5 times with 30–40 mL rinse solution; each rinse is filtered through a 0.2 µm filter.

substeps.instruction: Add 30–40 mL rinse solution, gently agitate, then filter through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Filter cumulative rinse volume
steps.instruction: Filter a total of 100–150 mL of the collected rinse solution through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Cut rinse filter and store
steps.instruction: Cut the rinse filter with a sterile scalpel, transfer it to a 5 mL centrifuge tube, flash freeze, and store for 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing.

steps.title: Final wash of duckweed tissue
steps.instruction: Wash the rinsed duckweed tissue twice with sterile water.

steps.title: Store duckweed tissue for sequencing
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed duckweed tissue to a 5 mL centrifuge tube, flash freeze, and store for 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing.
